root.label: Congressional Friends of Ireland Caucus urges reversal of Drumcree decision

events.label: Congressional Friends of Ireland Caucus urges reversal of Drumcree decision

slots.name: years since agreement
slots.sentence: “Over the last three decades, the progress made on the island of Ireland has been nothing short of extraordinary. Twenty-eight years have passed since the signing of the Good Friday agreement, and a generation has grown without a single memory of the Troubles,” the lawmakers wrote.
